source: NOAA CPC Africa Hazards Outlook (FEWS NET)
detail: Remains under abnormal dryness after sustained below-average rain, with below-average rain forecast for the week.
Liberia saw 30-day rainfall surpluses overall, but central/eastern Liberia stayed under abnormal dryness. Heavy rain was forecast for parts of Liberia.

source: NOAA CPC Africa Hazards Outlook (FEWS NET)
detail: Large 90-day deficits (over 100 mm) across Liberia, Sierra Leone and Côte d'Ivoire; the ITF was retreating south quickly.
Excess rain forecast along the Atlantic coast to central Liberia, but warmer-than-normal temperatures and deficit risk further east along the Gulf of Guinea.
